mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an active monetary easing policy, which reduces the cost of capital for corporations and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer and housing demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing sector weakness is amplified by rising input costs (CPIAUCSL), which compresses corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises from prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months indicates persistent labor market weakness, which reduces household disposable income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in both retail and residential sectors, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5% from prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
